name: Contact form
description: A contact form with name, e-mail, subject, message and privacy consent, in English, Spanish and Catalan, placed with the [contact] shortcode or a widget. Messages are e-mailed to the site administrator or a configured address, with Reply-To set to the visitor. Optionally, a Google Calendar appointment schedule beside the form, loaded when the visitor asks for it.
author: sap13ns

widgets.title: Contact form
widgets.description: The contact form, with the intro text and the privacy link from the plugin settings.

purpose.en: Shows the appointment calendar beside the contact form, to book a time. Nothing loads until you press the button; then Google receives your IP address and may store data on your device.
purpose.es: Muestra el calendario de citas junto al formulario de contacto, para reservar una hora. No se carga nada hasta que pulsas el botón; entonces Google recibe tu dirección IP y puede guardar datos en tu dispositivo.
purpose.ca: Mostra el calendari de cites al costat del formulari de contacte, per reservar una hora. No es carrega res fins que prems el botó; aleshores Google rep la teva adreça IP i pot desar dades al teu dispositiu.

settings.label: Send messages to
settings.help: Empty sends them to the site administrator.

settings.label: Subject prefix
settings.help: Starts the subject of every e-mail, so you can filter them.

settings.label: Privacy policy
settings.help: Link shown above the form: https://…, http://… or a site path such as /privacy. The consent checkbox refers to it.

settings.label: Privacy policy (Spanish pages)
settings.help: For example /es/privacidad. Empty uses the link above.

settings.label: Text above the form
settings.help: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Empty shows none.

settings.label: Message after sending
settings.help: {name} and {email} are replaced. Empty uses "Thanks, {name}! Your message was sent. We will reply to {email}." (in Spanish or Catalan on those pages).

settings.label: Appointment calendar
settings.help: A Google Calendar appointment schedule, shown beside the form: its address (https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/…) or the whole "Website embed" code Google gives. Empty shows the form alone.

settings.label: Text above the calendar
settings.help: Empty uses "Choose a free time in our calendar." (in Spanish or Catalan on those pages).

settings.label: Most links in a message
settings.help: Messages with more links are refused. 0 allows none.

label.en: I have read and accept the privacy policy
label.es: He leído y acepto la política de privacidad
label.ca: He llegit i accepto la política de privacitat
